## Summary

Built `bin/todo.js`, a dependency-free CLI implementing everything in `BRIEF.md`:
- `add <text…>` / `list` / `done <n>`, backed by JSON at `TODO_FILE` (or `todo.json` in cwd)
- All specified exit codes and messages: usage errors (exit 2), missing-item errors (exit 1, file untouched), invalid-JSON errors (exit 1 for every command, file untouched), unknown command (exit 2)

**Verification (TDD):** Wrote `test/todo.test.js` (13 cases using `node:test` + `child_process.spawnSync`, exercising the real CLI process against temp files) before writing any implementation code — confirmed all 11 initial tests failed for the right reason (CLI didn't exist), then implemented `bin/todo.js` and got all green. Added two more tests for gaps I noticed (default `TODO_FILE` path, `done` with no argument), watched the "no argument" one fail (NaN → wrong message), then fixed it. Final run: 13/13 passing via `npm test`. Also ran a manual end-to-end smoke test (add, done, list, bad item number, unknown command, corrupted JSON file) confirming output matches the spec byte-for-byte.

Also updated `README.md` with a usage section.
